usage: OpenCode V1 reviewer transport for native Gentle review collection. Prepared implementation routing is owned by prepared-routing-policy.json and Pi. Assurance routing is owned by the single assurance profile and never depends on the implementation profile.
review_profile_selection: none — one assurance profile serves every train

technical_review_failure.normalization: observable terminal required-review transport failure → typed technical failure

sol_policy: No normal-path Sol. Sol is not pinned to any assurance role.
